description.en: Curated DSH bundles that this installation does not ship, generated against DSH 0.2.1-rc.3.
description.zh: 精选的 DSH 组合包（只收本版 DSH 不带的），针对 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 生成并通过兼容性判定。

description.en: Delegate one task to Codex using its native authentication and settings.
description.zh: 使用 Codex 原生认证和设置委派单个任务。

description.en: Delegate one task to Claude Code using its native authentication and settings.
description.zh: 使用 Claude Code 原生认证和设置委派单个任务。

description.en: File tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat in one column, separate for every conversation.
description.zh: 把文件树、编辑器、变更、任务和侧边对话合并成一列，每个会话各自独立。

description.en: A registry-driven floating pet that reacts to model activity, with naming, petting and feeding.
description.zh: 注册表驱动的浮动宠物，会随模型活动反应，可命名、抚摸、投喂。

description.en: Tiny semantic inline emoji for DSH Agent responses.
description.zh: 给 Agent 回复加上语义化的小号内联 emoji。

description.en: Claude Code Desktop theme for the DSH web GUI: visual and interaction overhaul.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 界面换成 Claude Code Desktop 的视觉与交互。

description.en: Settings cards plus extra chat message nodes for DSH.
description.zh: 在设置页加卡片，并扩展对话消息节点。

description.en: Adaptive DSH companion with replaceable, extensible character packs.
description.zh: 带可替换、可扩展角色包的自适应桌面伙伴（体积较大）。

description.en: Discover, install, update and uninstall plugins in the active DSH Desktop or Web profile.
description.zh: 在桌面/Web profile 里发现、安装、更新、卸载插件。

description.en: Sidebar plugin for browsing, searching and one-click installing DSH plugins.
description.zh: 侧栏插件：浏览、搜索、猜你喜欢、一键安装、已装管理。

description.en: Manage skills and MCP servers from the DSH web sidebar plus the unified dsh-panel CLI.
description.zh: 从 Web 侧栏统一管理 skills 与 MCP 服务器，附带 dsh-panel CLI。

description.en: Register any git SKILL.md repo as a DSH skill from the CLI or the web panel.
description.zh: 把任意 git SKILL.md 仓库一键注册成 DSH 技能（CLI 或 Web 面板）。

description.en: Model-facing tools to create, read and update .docx, .xlsx and .pptx files.
description.zh: 让模型直接创建、读取、修改 Word / Excel / PowerPoint 文件。

description.en: Univer integration with inline previews, floating worktree windows and session-end review actions.
description.zh: Univer 预览、悬浮工作表窗口与会话结束复盘动作（体积很大）。

description.en: Preview, restore and delete archived sessions from the settings page.
description.zh: 在设置页预览、恢复、删除已归档会话。

description.en: Centralized inventory, batch archive/restore, physical delete and optional auto-archive.
description.zh: 集中清单、批量归档/恢复、物理删除（含家族级联）与可选自动归档。

description.en: Read-only DSH session insights and local model usage statistics.
description.zh: 只读的会话洞察与本地模型用量统计。

description.en: Smart checkpoints, workspace safety guards and instant rollback.
description.zh: 智能检查点、工作区安全守卫与一键回滚。

description.en: Isolated agent runs with script/HTTP/SSH/Docker runtimes, cost guard and notifications.
description.zh: 隔离的 agent 运行、脚本/HTTP/SSH/Docker 运行时、成本守卫与通知。

description.en: Edit a custom mode: system prompt, base mode and plugin switches.
description.zh: 编辑自定义模式的系统提示、基础模式与插件开关。

description.en: Auto-adjust reasoning_effort per tool round, with optional manual lock and timing telemetry.
description.zh: 按工具轮次自动调整 reasoning_effort，可手动锁定并记录耗时。

description.en: 331 summonable domain experts for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 331 名可召唤的专业智能体。

description.en: Declare named subagents in TOML files under ~/.dsh/agents and the project root.
description.zh: 在 ~/.dsh/agents 与项目内用 TOML 声明命名子代理。

description.en: OpenViking memory and context bundle for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供记忆与上下文管理（火山引擎 OpenViking）。

description.en: Host config store, persistent ssh2 connection pool and remote operations for the web GUI.
description.zh: 主机配置存储（可从 ~/.ssh/config 导入）、持久连接池与远程操作。

description.en: Podman-backed execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 用 Podman 容器执行 DSH 的命令与工具。

description.en: Character cards, worldbooks, presets, memory and relations (PolyForm noncommercial license).
description.zh: 角色卡、世界书、预设、记忆与关系（PolyForm 非商业许可）。
